mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic conditions.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns show no positive correlation with FEDFUNDS decline (Rank IC < 0.03) across any 3-year rolling window or fail t-test significance (p > 0.05) in easing periods.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signal a contraction in the housing sector that weakens consumer demand, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when both RSAFS and HOUST decline, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production declining below 100 index signals manufacturing supply chain disruption that elevates inflation and reduces corporate profitability, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.5% signals persistent inflation that triggers hawkish monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when CPIAUCSL > 3.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns show no positive correlation with PAYEMS growth (Rank IC < 0.03) across any 3-year rolling window or fail t-test significance (p > 0.05) in strong labor periods.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions (GDP growth > 2.5% annualized), a decline in consumer spending (RSAFS) signals an impending economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when GDPC1 > 2.5% and RSAFS declines, or combined condition Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and rises in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signal dual supply-labor market shocks that increase recession risk, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when INDPRO declines and UNRATE rises, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.
